definitions.explanation: A count of six people, using the Sino-Japanese number {六|ろく} with the counter {人|にん}. Note that {六|ろく} keeps its full form here — there is no small-tsu change as in {六本|ろっぽん} or {六個|ろっこ}.

examples.japanese: {六人|ろくにん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: Six of us will stay the night.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六人|ろくにん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{入|はい}れ→入る：00494_hairu⟧ます。
examples.english: Up to six people can fit in this room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六人|ろくにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The committee is made up of six members and meets once a month.

notes:
⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧ plus the counter ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ for people.

WHICH READING:
ろくにん only. Many counters turn ⟦{六|ろく}→六：00747_roku⟧ into ろっ (⟦{六本|ろっぽん}→六本：27650_roppon⟧, {六階|ろっかい}, {六匹|ろっぴき}), but ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ is not one of them.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {六人|ろくにん}で: as a group of six
- {六人|ろくにん}⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧: a family of six
- {六人|ろくにん}{掛|が}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧: a six-seater sofa

RELATED COUNTS:
- ⟦{五人|ごにん}→五人：30567_gonin⟧: five people
- ⟦{七人|しちにん}→七人：30350_shichinin⟧: seven people
